name: tokenscout-workspace
description: Turn undocumented live client websites into evidence-backed redesign baselines.

scripts.build: npm run build -w tokenscout && npm run build -w @tokenscout/transform && npm run build -w @tokenscout/extract
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w tokenscout && npm run typecheck -w tokenscout && npm run typecheck -w @tokenscout/transform && npm run typecheck -w @tokenscout/extract
scripts.test: npm run build -w tokenscout && npm run test -w tokenscout && npm run test -w @tokenscout/transform && npm run test -w @tokenscout/extract
